# Elly Korving

> Elly Elizabeth Korving is a Dutch identity, life and business coach based in the Amsterdam area, the Netherlands. With 25+ years as an entrepreneur in branding and marketing, she guides entrepreneurs, leaders and professionals to recognise the patterns that shape their choices and to live and work from who they truly are. She works in Dutch and English. Her approach is called Harmonic Mirror. She is the founder of 110 Life & Business Awareness and the creator of SZINN.ai.

## Key facts
- Name: Elly Korving (Elly Elizabeth Korving)
- Role: identity coach, life coach, business coach
- Location: Amsterdam area (Noord-Holland), the Netherlands
- Languages: Dutch, English
- Contact: elly@szinn.ai · book a conversation: https://calendar.app.google/i1XXp48q3C2p34ef7
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/-elly-elizabeth-korving/

## Approach: Harmonic Mirror
Three roles — mirror, guide and bridge. Five themes: mirror, resonance, awareness, stillness, imagination. Elly does not tell people who to be; she helps them see the patterns and beliefs behind their choices.

## Work and offerings
- [SZINN.ai — SZINN Alignment Blueprint](https://szinn.ai/): a personal report based on date, time and place of birth, combining astrology, numerology and Kabbalah. Reviews: https://szinn.ai/reviews
- [110 Life & Business Awareness](https://www.110lifeandbusiness.com/): programmes on identity, awareness and conscious entrepreneurship, including Entering Transformation and Being the Laws of My Universe.
- One-to-one guidance (6 or 12 months), group coaching with a weekly community and mastermind, and business coaching.
- [Rebalance Energy Centre](https://rebalance.energy/): deep relaxation through light, sound and stillness, Gondel 1, Amstelveen.
- [Alterego Marketing](https://alteregomarketing.com/): positioning, brand design and activation.
